nodes.summary: GeneGISTIC null (Mermel et al. 2011): permuting the per-sample minima of all running windows of `n + 1` markers gives, at every window `i`, the law of a sum of independent draws of one window minimum per sample.
nodes.title: GeneGISTIC null

nodes.summary: (Mermel et al. 2011): the probability of the score `g` is the fraction of the `M ^ S` marker choices with that score, whatever the marker `m`.
nodes.title: The GISTIC permutation null is the law of a sum of independent per-sample draws

nodes.summary: Adding sample `S` convolves the null of the first `S` samples with the empirical law of the new sample, `P_{S+1}(g) = ∑_v (1 / M) P_S(g - x_S(v))`.
nodes.title: Convolution step

nodes.summary: With no samples the null is the point mass at `0`.
nodes.title: GISTIC null with no samples is a point mass at zero

nodes.summary: The GISTIC permutation null at marker `m`: the probability that `∑ j, x j (σ j m) = g` when the permutations `σ j` of the markers are independent and uniform.
nodes.title: GISTIC permutation null distribution

nodes.summary: The permuted score at marker `m`: `∑ j, x j (σ j m)`.
nodes.title: Permuted GISTIC score at a marker

nodes.summary: The number of marker choices `u : Fin S → Fin M` (one marker per sample) with `∑ j, x j (u j) = g`.
nodes.title: Count of marker choices with a given score

nodes.summary: The minimum of `y` over the window of `n + 1` consecutive markers starting at `i` (GeneGISTIC's per-sample gene-level value for a gene covering those markers).
nodes.title: Window minimum over consecutive markers

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
